predictions.prediction_text: If gamma increases, local delta-hedging flow will counter momentum and compress daily returns.
predictions.expected_result: Daily returns will show reduced dispersion (lower daily return volatility) compared to prior period.

predictions.prediction_text: When customers are long upside IV skew (long upside gamma and vega), dealers short gamma/vega will trade with the momentum and create illiquidity.
predictions.expected_result: Market liquidity on upside moves will deteriorate, producing larger price moves and wider bid-ask spreads during upside momentum.

predictions.prediction_text: When customers short vomma (sell volatility-of-volatility), momentum will face counterflow and volatility will be suppressed reflexively.
predictions.expected_result: Implied and realized volatility will decline and exhibit muted spikes compared to periods without short vomma positioning.
